programmes.name: HiQuarter Month 1
programmes.title: Training Program – Jumping and athletic's stuff (Phase 1 – Month 1)
progression: Main lifts: S1 at the given RIR → S2 +1–5% → S3 same weight and +1 set → S4 +1–5%.
Accessories: S1 RIR 0–2 → S2 either +1 set at the same weight or +2–10% → alternating weight increases and set additions.
Plyos: hold the RPE and add sets.
PRH: fewer reps and longer holds each week, adding weight.

programmes.name: HiQuarter Month 2
programmes.title: Training Program – Jumping and athletic's stuff – Month 2 (M2)
progression: Main lifts: RIR 2-3 → +1-5% → same weight +1 set → +1-5%.
Contrast/mechanical-drop giant sets (plyo variant → standard variant → isometric hold, all to RER 0).
